Photo 2 shows the EA SPORTS FC 25 loading screen on the monitor.
No photo clearly shows the console model label (Xbox One vs Series X/S vs Series 1X), storage size, serial number, or the exact game list beyond FC 25.

claims.evidence: Photos only clearly show EA SPORTS FC 25 on the screen; the full list of 6 games and the exact console model are not readable.

claims.claim: Fc 26, far cry 3, modern warfare 3, dishonored 2 and tomb...
claims.evidence: Only FC 25 is clearly visible on the monitor; the other titles are not shown/readable in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of seals/stickers/inside; cannot confirm from external images.
No temperature/thermal test or error history shown.
No close-up test of HDMI/USB/Ethernet/audio ports in the photos.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Photos show a controller, but do not clearly show 'original pads' (what exactly) or a UK receipt.

risks.risk: Exact console model is unclear (seller says 'series 1x', but photos don’t show the model name/label). Wrong model affects price and compatibility.
risks.proof: Photo of the console’s bottom/side label showing the exact Xbox model (e.g., Series X/Series S/Xbox One) + serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for an unknown/possibly older Xbox console with limited proof of condition.

risks.risk: Game bundle claim may be overstated: only FC 25 is clearly shown; other games may not be installed or may require accounts/discs.
risks.proof: Screen recording or photo of the 'My games & apps' library showing all installed titles (scroll through to confirm 6).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if only the clearly shown game is installed.

risks.risk: Port functionality not verified (HDMI/USB/Ethernet). A console can power on but have a faulty port.
risks.proof: Short video showing HDMI output + at least 2 USB devices/controllers recognized + (if applicable) Ethernet link.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed for all ports.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues not testable from photos; could fail under load.
risks.proof: Clip showing 20–30 minutes of gameplay with no shutdown/errors (or a stress test screenshot/log).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if overheating risk exists (worst-case: treat as needing inspection).

risks.risk: Receipt/original accessories may be missing or not original.
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt and all included accessories laid out (controllers, cables, pads) with clear labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming receipt/original accessories are included.

proof_requests: Photo of the console model label (bottom/side) showing exact Xbox model + serial number.
Photo/screenshot (or short screen recording) of 'My games & apps' showing all installed games (confirm 6).
Video test: HDMI display + controller pairing + USB port test (and Ethernet if available).
Clip showing 20–30 minutes gameplay without shutdown/errors.
Photos of included items laid out: controllers/pads/cables + the UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox is running EA SPORTS FC 25, but the exact console model and the full '6 games installed' bundle (plus ports/accessories/condition) are not verifiable from the images. Without the model label and installed-game list, a worst-case price cannot be chosen confidently.
